text: {"lessons":["My account has moved up and down even over a short stretch, so I should avoid reacting to every monthly change and stick to a deliberate plan.","Selling some Stock E after a large gain reduced my exposure and realized proceeds, but one successful sale does not prove I can time the market; I should base future trades on my plan, not assume recent gains will continue.","I want to buy an apartment within ten years, so I should balance growth with the risk I can afford and review progress over a longer horizon rather than judge it by a few periods."]}
